rulings.Case Title: YUAN ZHOU ET AL VS. LANFANG ZHENG ET AL
rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice Of Motion And Motion To Determine Purchase Price Including Offsets And Costs Of Partition; Memorandum Of Points And Authorities In Support Thereof; Declaration Of Scott Talkov
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for July 20, 2026. Line 1. PLAINTIFF YUAN ZHOU , AN INDIVIDUAL, DONGYANG ZHANG Notice Of Motion And Motion To Determine Purchase Price Including Offsets And Costs Of Partition; The Court notes that the Plaintiff for the first time in this case confirmed unequivocally in writing that they "request a sale." (Compare to prior filings and Court's March 10, 2026 ruling). Defendant's Notice of Election of Buyout of Cotenant Interest having been on file since October 21, 2025 (filed and remaining on file while Plaintiff calendared motions without committing to partition by sale request) coupled with Plaintiff's now clarified position, triggers the issuance of notice under CCP 874.317(d). The Court hereby provides such notice and sets the date pursuant to CCP 874.317 of October 26, 2026. Defendants shall deposit 45 percent of the difference between the amount remaining on the mortgage and the stipulated value of $1,663,700. Parties to provide the exact number (accounting to the outstanding mortgage as of July 20, 2026) in writing no later than 9:00 a.m. on July 20, 2026. Any outstanding accounting issues, offsets and costs to be addressed at October 26, 2026 trial. =(501/CFH) Parties may appear in-person, telephonically or via Zoom (Video - Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849; or Phone Dial in: (669) 254-5252; Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849). Parties who intend to appear at the hearing must give notice to opposing parties and the court promptly, but no later than 4:00 p.m. the court day before the hearing unless the tentative ruling has specified that a hearing is required.
